summaryZh: Baxter Lab 结合眼科学与信息学，通过健康信息技术改善视觉与健康。研究包括电子病历日志分析、遥感设备整合、机器学习、自然语言处理及人工智能临床应用。

evidence.quote: The Baxter Lab We perform innovative and cross-disciplinary research in ophthalmology and informatics
Analyses of electronic health record (EHR) audit log data
Predictive modeling / machine learning Natural language processing Implementation of AI models into clinical practice
under the direction of Dr. Sally Baxter.
Shiley Eye Institute at UC San Diego
